title: Assistant or Associate Professor of Cell Biology - Charlottesville, Virginia job with University of Virginia | 12865253
gist: Job posting: the University of Virginia School of Medicine's Department of Cell Biology is recruiting two tenure-eligible early/mid-career faculty in mechanistic cell and developmental biology, with rolling review until December 31, 2026. Little investment signal beyond continued academic hiring that weights sustained extramural funding.

insights.claim: The University of Virginia School of Medicine's Department of Cell Biology is hiring two tenure-eligible faculty on its Academic Investigator track, preferring early and mid-career investigators, with applications reviewed on a rolling basis until December 31, 2026.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Minor signal that US academic biomedical hiring continues despite funding pressures.
insights.quote: invites applications for two tenure-eligible faculty positions on the Academic Investigator (AI) track with preference for early and mid-career investigators

insights.claim: The UVA department's stated research strengths include morphogenesis, cytoskeletal dynamics, membrane organelle trafficking, stem cell biology, developmental signaling and genomics, and disease biology such as cancer and ciliopathies.
